title: AI Engineer
description:
AI Engineer

London (Hybrid/In-Office) | £130,000 - £160,000

This is an opportunity to join a high-calibre engineering team building production-grade AI systems that solve complex, real-world business challenges. You'll work on cutting-edge LLM applications, agentic workflows, retrieval systems, and AI infrastructure, with the chance to influence technical direction and contribute to a fast-growing product at the forefront of applied artificial intelligence.

The Company

They are a rapidly growing technology business developing AI-powered solutions that help organisations unlock value from complex, data-rich environments. Their platform combines advanced machine learning, large language models, and workflow automation to support critical decision-making processes.

The Role

  • Build and deploy agentic AI workflows using tools such as LangGraph and LangChain.
  • Design and optimise RAG pipelines, including vector search, embeddings, and retrieval strategies.
  • Develop LLM-powered applications for document intelligence, classification, extraction, and reasoning.
  • Create evaluation frameworks and observability tooling to monitor AI performance, quality, and cost.
  • Engineer scalable backend services using Python, FastAPI, cloud technologies, and modern software engineering practices.

Your Skills & Experience

  • Strong commercial experience developing software and AI applications in Python.
  • Hands-on experience building and deploying LLM, generative AI, or machine learning systems in production.
  • Expertise with LangGraph, LangChain, or similar orchestration frameworks.
  • Experience designing and improving RAG architectures and vector database solutions.
  • Knowledge of AI evaluation, observability, and cloud-based software engineering best practices.

How to Apply

If you're an AI/ML Engineer looking to work on advanced AI products and tackle complex technical challenges, apply today to find out more about this opportunity.
